# Slabsy

> Slabsy is a premium display system for graded, certified comic books (CGC, CBCS, ECG and compatible slabs). Designed in Italy. Website: https://www.slabsy.it — Sales via Etsy. Contact: info@slabsy.it, +39 328 924 7893.

## Products (prices VAT included, list of July 2026) — all 3D printed in black PLA
- SLABSY STAND V.1 — €27.00 — tabletop stand, stable base, optimal viewing angle, no label slot.
- SLABSY STAND V.2 — €34.00 — tabletop stand, stable base, optimal viewing angle, removable customizable label slot, 1 label included.
- SLABSY WALL V.1 — €32.00 — wall-mounted display, quick mounting, modern design, no label slot.
- SLABSY WALL V.2 — €39.00 — wall-mounted display, quick mounting, removable customizable label slot, 1 label included.

## Material
- 3D printed in PLA, a bioplastic made from renewable plant sources (e.g. corn or sugar cane starch).
- Light yet rigid; precise slots thanks to 3D printing; custom shims and labels made on demand.
- Care: keep away from strong heat and prolonged direct sunlight.

## Key features
- Interchangeable shims adapt the base to different slab thicknesses, up to 30 mm, for staple-bound and perfect-bound comics.
- Compatible with CGC, CBCS, ECG and other certified slab formats ("modern" comics).
- Original and custom labels (styles: Noir, Pop Art, Cosmic, Golden Age, Neon); Sketch Labels designed to be signed or sketched by artists.
- Services: custom shims for display bases, custom labels.
- Design philosophy: "Subtract, don't add" — the display should not steal the scene, it should support it.
